content_of_post_to_comment: Really not a fan of how pervasive analytics have become in baseball. If your ace pitcher's cruising along and you're winning the game -- you leave him IN. To hell with what some computer or pocket protector-wearing nerd says.
comment: The irony is that analytics can optimize a pitcher’s odds of staying healthy while costing him the chance to own the moment. We’ve gotten better at managing risk, but have we confused that with managing a game?
